Use this page to prepare a SCGSim source checkout for documentation and package contributions. Install [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/) and Git first. The [installation tutorial](course/installation.qmd) covers the separate Python environment for a simulation study and the native solver host.

Clone the development branch, then sync the checkout using its `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock`:

```bash
git clone --branch develop https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim.git
cd scgsim
uv sync --locked --extra palace --extra dev --all-groups
```

`uv sync` creates the checkout's `.venv` and installs the project with the `palace` and `dev` extras plus all dependency groups declared in `pyproject.toml`. This includes the repository's test and quality tools. `--locked` uses the checked-in `uv.lock` and stops if it does not match the project metadata.

Read [architecture and data flow](architecture.qmd) for module ownership, the [maintainer guide](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim/blob/develop/MAINTAINING.md) for repository and documentation maintenance, and the [documentation map](documentation-map.qmd) to find each page's role.
